title: TSMC buys 10% of Intel's IMS Nanofabrication unit

sources.quote: Approved the purchase of 10% equity interest in IMS Nanofabrication Global, LLC from Intel Corporation for an amount not exceeding US$432.8 million.

In 2023, we closed agreements to sell a combined 32% minority stake in our IMS business, a business within our Intel Foundry operating segment—including a 20% stake to Bain Capital Special Situations and a 10% stake to TSMC.

explain: TSMC paid Intel for a 10% stake in IMS Nanofabrication, an Intel-owned Austrian company that makes the multi-beam machines used to write chip photomasks. TSMC's board capped the price at $432.8 million; the sale closed in 2023.
